_comment: Flip i18n - English text resources. Supports flat keys (backwards compatible) and dot-notation for nested access.
welcome_banner: Your Intelligent Assistant for Personal Knowledge Management and AI-Powered Content Generation

intro.title: Welcome to Flip
intro.description: Flip manages external knowledge bases without moving your notes.
intro.brain_concept: Brain: A single knowledge base directory (Obsidian, Logseq, Dendron, markdown)
intro.workspace_concept: Workspace: A named collection of related brains
intro.default_workspace_info: The 'default' workspace contains all brains Flip knows about on this machine
intro.quickstart_new_brain: flip brain new            # Create a new brain with a compatible structure
intro.quickstart_add_brain: flip brain add <path>     # Connect an existing brain directory
intro.quickstart_status: flip status               # See your workspaces and brains
intro.tip_create_workspace: Use 'flip workspace create <name>' to organize brains by context (e.g., personal/work)
intro.tip_set_default: Set a default brain per workspace with 'flip brain set-default <name>'
intro.tip_repair: Repair your registry anytime with 'flip workspace repair'
